versions.subject: feat: more updates and fixes

selection_parent:
    #GrandParentImage|endswith: '\sihost.exe'
    ParentImage|contains: 'C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\'

    Image|endswith:
        # You can add more LOLBINs
        - '\poweshell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\rundll32.exe'
